newsitem.title: UK: BZW strengthens banking, insurance research.
newsitem.headline: BZW strengthens banking, insurance research.

text.p: British investment bank BZW said on Tuesday it had strengthened its banking and insurance research team with the appointment of three new analysts.
BZW, the investment banking arm of banking giant Barclays Plc, has hired Patrick Barton as UK banking analyst, working alongside BZW's Tim Sykes.
Barton will join the firm later in the year from Norwich Union Plc, where he is investment director.
The firm said in a statement it had also poached Tim Dawson, 37, and Roland Andreasson, 38, from ABN AMRO Hoare Govett to cover the pan-European insurance sector.
BZW said it had recruited seven senior analysts since the beginning of the year.
"We are very excited about these strategic hires," Steve Harker, head of the equities division said.
